import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from parse import compile

# Test various alignments
test_cases = [
    ('{:}', 'hello'),           # default
    ('{:<}', 'hello'),          # left, no width
    ('{:>}', 'hello'),          # right, no width
    ('{:^}', 'hello'),          # center, no width
    ('{:<10}', 'hello'),        # left, width 10
    ('{:>10}', 'hello'),        # right, width 10
    ('{:^10}', 'hello'),        # center, width 10
]

for fmt, text in test_cases:
    p = compile(fmt)
    result = p.parse(text)
    if result:
        print(f'{fmt!r:15} {text!r:15} -> {result.fixed[0]!r}')
    else:
        print(f'{fmt!r:15} {text!r:15} -> NO MATCH')
" 2>&1
